finding: Web Audio render progression can be evidenced independently from human audibility by validating multiple non-zero, advancing getOutputTimestamp samples. outputLatency is optional because Safari may not expose it.

primary_sources.title: Web Audio API 1.1 Editor's Draft
observations: Zero contextTime and performanceTime indicate that no render block has been processed.
After rendering starts, currentTime exceeds contextTime.
currentTime minus contextTime is not a reliable latency estimate.

primary_sources.title: Web Audio API 1.1 Editor's Draft
observations: The value may change with platform and output hardware.
Safari support is absent in the specification's compatibility data.

epistemic_limits: Render progression does not prove human audibility.
Estimated acoustic time is unavailable without outputLatency.
The 250 ms coherence threshold is an operational capture guard, not a Web Audio conformance requirement.
No physical iPhone observation or immutable Vercel deployment was available in this slice.
falsification_route: Feed zero or non-advancing output timestamps and require rejection.
Provide a running context whose currentTime does not exceed contextTime and require rejection.
Compare a later physical-device attestation against the render classification; disagreement must remain represented rather than collapsed.
